title: Andrew Garfield Explains the Robin Hood Energy in ‘The Uprising’ — and Why Marketing Noise Doesn’t Faze Him
summary: The two-time Oscar nominee also reflects on his 'Social Network' co-star Jesse Eisenberg’s decision not to return as Mark Zuckerberg for Aaron Sorkin’s 'The Social Reckoning,' and looks ahead to his own turn as a Big Tech disrupter in 'Artificial.'
